author: jerbear64
body:
EDIT: I've updated the map with some suggestions! The screenshots are updated to reflect this, as well as some of the description.

This is my first map so I'll gladly accept criticism. I don't care how harsh it is, feel free to tell me my map outright sucks. I'm fine with it. :P

Map Name: Circulate

Map Creator: jerbear64

Map Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/amje3hilmsf2fmx/Circulate.zip

YAML: http://hastebin.com/iyihobojih.sm


This map is intended to make defense a larger role. The map is fairly open, and there isn't much cover for the monuments, however, the monuments are more well-guarded by default than most maps, and defense is supposed to play a major role in this map.

This is what one side of the map looks like. The spawn is in the center, which leads to four different pathways out. Players can either continue straight to get to the lower level, or climb up to get to the upper level.


There are some islands in the center of the map. The outermost two are for extra PVP space, while the center has some more "public" resources, accessible to both teams. This is to show that while defense is important, players will still need good offensive skill to score as many of these resources as possible in order to take the lead.


Here's one of the monuments up close. It's guarded relatively well by itself but it isn't enough, players still have to defend them.


You've probably already noticed this, but each team also has their own supply of iron. The only diamonds in the map, however, are in the "pool" island in the middle of the map.

Again, I accept criticism, feel free to tell me what's wrong with the map and I'll do my best to fix it.

replies.author: dilpickel
replies.body:
Its a good start but your guna have to make some improvements.
I would suggest making the islands much bigger and a bit closer.
Over all looks dull, could use lots more detail and color.
Some tips would be to hide the bed rock,
 add some random to the land so it doesn't look like you just used world edit/ MC edit,
 add more islands and PvP space,
 add some depth to the map so your not just fighting on a flat surface.
Also add a pic showing the entire map.
Hope it helps!

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
I am sorry to say but your map, Circulate, has been denied for testing on the Avicus Network.

To Improve your map, the map developers suggest you make the map more unique and less simple. It looks like cylinders from world edit and is stale and boring. Make unique shapes and not just a single shape every time :P


If you have any other questions on how to improve your map, Find me on TeamSpeak or Message me on Skype (Sethskye).


You may resubmit your map once edited.
